thread_title: S. leucophylla var. alba 'spring white' Washington Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla var. alba 'spring white' Washington Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Normally by now, all the leucophyllas are in full force. This season, they are maybe 2 weeks behind due to the unusually long cold spring/early summer. That said, the many of the washington Co, AL genetics are 2-3 weeks earlier than most, and this clone is not disappointing!
